about: The misses log — every time Pavan has to point out something that should already have been right (or Claude breaks something). Claude adds an entry the moment it happens. `npm run eval` reads this file: it counts misses per week, shows how many are guarded by a script, and lists the guards still to build. Goal: the weekly count falls to 0. `npm run misses` regenerates misses.md from this file.

patterns.stale-rule: A written rule or old note won over Pavan's newer instruction
patterns.by-block: Applied to the code block being edited, not to everything the user sees on that screen/stage
patterns.one-case: Verified one case only (one row, one order, one stage, one theme)
patterns.partial-unify: Unified some parts of a unit (position, colour) but not all (anatomy, spacing)
patterns.edges: Didn't look at the edges — last rows, card rims, repeated values, empty states
patterns.unsafe-edit: A scripted edit or tool run that damaged files
patterns.unchecked-output: A sweep or generated output assumed correct without checking the result
patterns.generic-over-existing: Reached for a generic component instead of the closest pattern already in the app
patterns.no-guard: No guard against an impossible value or state

checkStatus.built: A script in `npm run eval` guards it — the id is a check name
checkStatus.proposed: A script could guard it; not built yet (shows as open in the eval)
checkStatus.manual: Needs eyes — the Level 5 rubric / screenshots
checkStatus.process: Not a product defect; guarded by a working rule in memory

misses.title: Alert banner placed above the toolbar in every module
misses.why: Asked to match 3PL, I followed the 2026-10-11 written rule (above the toolbar) instead of the screen he pointed to.

misses.title: Banner and its pills used opacity fills; banner too blue
misses.why: Reused the soft /10 alpha recipe without checking it against his solid-fill rule from the board lanes.

misses.title: "Needs action" alert had a different structure from the other alerts
misses.why: Unified the banner's position and colour, not each alert's anatomy.

misses.title: US English sweep missed "fulfilment"
misses.why: The replace list matched `fulfil` with word boundaries, not `fulfilment`; the result was never grepped for leftovers.

misses.title: Left-align sweep left the Qty and Top off headers centred
misses.why: Removed text-right but added no text-left; a bare <th> centres. Checked cells, not headers.

misses.title: Text size widened boxes
misses.why: Kept the earlier 'widen only if cut' behaviour instead of confirming 'only the text grows'.

misses.title: Stage-track jump failed on saved orders
misses.why: Wired only the create view's section names; saved orders name them differently. Caught in verification.

misses.title: Registry committed (22 MB) with install links that never worked
misses.why: Generated install URLs without checking the real remote or whether the repo is public.

misses.title: 1,100 lines of src/index.css deleted by a cleanup script
misses.why: A re.S pattern ending in .* ran to the end of the file; the dev server kept old CSS so the preview looked fine; no git diff --stat.

misses.title: Whole board file reformatted by Prettier
misses.why: Ran a formatter the repo doesn't use.

misses.title: Board view bar detached while the table's was attached
misses.why: Never compared the two units of one family side by side.

misses.title: Toolbar spacing 20px between date and view switch vs 12px elsewhere
misses.why: Never measured the toolbar's gaps as one set.

misses.title: On fulfillment could show 1052%
misses.why: The 2026-10-22 'not capped' decision was built without asking whether an impossible order should be enterable.

misses.title: Qty column cramped, 'gal' suffix floating mid-cell
misses.why: Adding the readings columns didn't trigger a re-check of widths.

misses.title: Multi-select of assets lost on filled rows
misses.where: 3PL DO asset picker (and 6 other row pickers)
misses.why: The multi-pick rule was applied only to blank rows; my test used a blank row.

misses.title: Duplicate asset names in the picker
misses.why: Data issue surfaced only when the list was filtered.

misses.title: Pricing Total row drew a double stroke
misses.why: border-y on the last row stacked on the card rim; never inspected the bottom edge.

misses.title: "Delivered" shown twice (input + its own figure)
misses.why: Older pattern never read critically while working on the same unit.

misses.title: Two highlighted cards on one sheet
misses.where: CP order sheet, CP action sheet
misses.why: No rule existed; the highlighted card was reused for any rail card.

misses.title: Read-view heading applied to some units only (Vendor stayed 16px)
misses.why: Changed headings inside the read-only block; Vendor lives outside it.

misses.title: Gap between Load order and Pricing — three rounds
misses.why: The gap comes from the rail's height, which changes by stage; tested one stage each time, and the first fix changed something not asked for.

misses.title: Vendor picker built as segmented tabs, not the saved-views tabs
misses.why: Picked a generic component over the closest existing pattern.

misses.title: Read-only card headers too loud
misses.why: Visual weight never compared against the one card that should lead.

misses.title: Stray draft autosaved while testing the CP create form
misses.why: Opened a create form to inspect it; autosave made a draft.

misses.title: "Pending: Vendor not selected" truncated on the narrower cards
misses.why: Narrowed the lanes to 340px without re-checking the longest footer text on every lane.

misses.title: V4 Completed date styled unlike the Orders schedule line, truncated; Assigned had no date
misses.why: Restyled the schedule unit only, not the Completed on unit that plays the same role in later lanes; never checked every lane for a date.

misses.title: Fill contrast slider skipped board fills: lane titles, count bubbles, code discs, dark buttons/fields
misses.where: Accessibility panel → every board and toolbar
misses.why: New fill tokens (lane soft/vivid titles, lane count, pastels, field fill) were added without WCAG/max values or a place in a11y.ts BACKGROUND; never swept the page for fills that stay put at 100%.

misses.title: V1/V1.1 vendor kept the building icon after the handshake change
misses.why: Swapped the vendor icon to a handshake on V2–V4 only; the V1 label helper kept the old icon.

misses.title: Tabbed asset dropdown resized and jumped when switching tabs
misses.where: 3PL order sheet → Delivery Order → Asset picker
misses.why: Added tabs without fixing the popover height; a list that grows and shrinks per tab moves the dropdown (and can flip it).

misses.title: Load Order Terminal said "No options" for lubes and propane — sample data ran out again
misses.why: Seeded loading accounts for fuel only; never checked every product (or every picker) had something to pick. Second time in a day after the empty asset tabs.

misses.title: Asked to move the Tags tick next to the text; changed the fee Type ("tax") picker instead
misses.why: Read "tag" as "tax" and never found a tax picker with a tick to confirm the guess; fixed only the table picker, not the shared dropdown row (CommandItem) every picker uses.

misses.title: Preferred-time labels stayed stuck to the thicker bar
misses.where: Order sheet → Delivery window & preferred time
misses.why: Thickened the bar and moved the read-only label's offset, but not the pressable label (the one every editable sheet shows); never measured the gap after.

misses.title: Said every dropdown had the tick column; Customer/ShipTo/Order Type/POC (Combobox) still had the tick on the left
misses.why: Changed CommandItem and the table pickers, then claimed Combobox matched without opening one — it draws its own rows.

misses.title: List view picked row used the brand-orange selection tint; the board's cards never use it
misses.why: Reached for --fp-row-selected (a ticked table row) instead of the card's own states; a picked card is the card pressed, not a ticked row.

misses.title: List view drew the order type as a word pill; the board card shows the coloured initial (CodeDisc)
misses.why: Took the table's Type pill instead of the card the rows were built from; the rows are the card's content, so its parts come with them.

misses.title: Quoting orders with quotes in said "Vendor not selected"; the step depends on invites sent / quotes in
misses.where: 3PL board cards + List view rows (Orders lane)
misses.why: One label for every vendor-less order; only the Draft-with-no-invites case was ever looked at.

misses.title: List view kept the Pricing totals bar while the rail's summary card was already on screen
misses.why: The bar was tuned for the slide-in sheet only; docking changed what is on screen and the bar was not re-checked against the 'never both summaries' rule.

misses.title: Archiving board V2 brought the view bar back; the tools-beside-the-switch layout had been decided
misses.where: Every list with a table or board (3PL first)
misses.why: Treated the tools-beside layout as part of the archived V2 trial instead of a separate decision; the decision was never written down as a rule, so the default (bar) came back.

misses.title: Asset 360's three views used the small SheetTable under a search/filter bar — no sorting, moving, resizing, column search, row open; rows capped at 25
misses.why: Reached for the record sheet's related-records table instead of the list's full table unit, though the views had become filterable lists.

misses.title: Table unit shrank to its three rows — the frame must stay full height with pagination at its foot
misses.why: Sized the table to its rows; the full-unit rule (frame fills, pagination below) was only true of list pages, not written for tables inside sheets.

misses.title: Read-only Asset 360 sheet kept the footer rule and a Confirm button with nothing to confirm
misses.why: RecordSheet always drew its footer; the sheet's submit only closed it.

misses.title: Documents drawn as an Attached/Pending status pill instead of the documents cell
misses.where: Master Data › Assets › Asset 360 movement orders
misses.why: Copied the reference's wording instead of the documents unit the app already has (icon + count + breakdown).

misses.title: Asset 360 tables: a Status filter on a value with no column (journey), a blank Status on half the log, a Type filter emptying tabs it does not apply to, and a second date-time format
misses.why: Built the global filter and the log from the data, not from what each table shows; did not copy the board card's date-time format.

misses.title: Asset journey said the same thing twice ("Received into the fleet at Irving Hub · New unit received"), and the lifeline bars had outlines
misses.where: Master Data › Assets › Asset 360 › Asset journey
misses.why: Printed the data's note next to a title built from the same fact, without reading the line as a whole; the log also added audit rows for invoices and moves that already had their own rows.
